---
title: Add Coupon
description: >-
  Customizing coupon visuals, setting redemption rules and active dates, and
  categorizing them for web or POS distribution.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="892" height="493" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Incentive > Add Coupon. Set visuals of your coupon branding and enter the coupon details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="168" height="52" style="width: 168px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="422" height="275" style="width: 422px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2.

- Fill in the titles and detailed descriptions in different language.

* Assign a category and a display order, then click Submit to activate the reward.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="548" height="271" style="width: 548px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. **Optional:&#x20;**&#x73;etting specific rules and limits on how a coupon can be earned and used.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="376" height="221" style="width: 376px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
